Modifier - context-dependent: pulse width (PULSE), detune (dual-osc),
FM depth (BELL), spread mix (SPREAD OCT / SPREAD 5TH).
Master output level for this engine (0..1, default 0.8).
How much note velocity controls volume (0 = ignore velocity, 1 = full tracking)
Pitch envelope amount (semitones, bipolar; negative = pitch drops, positive = rises)
Transient level at note onset (0 = off). Adds a short HPF'd noise 'click' before the envelope.
Transient colour - HPF cutoff (200 Hz = thumpy, 10 kHz = bright click).
Unison voice count (1-7). 1 = off. 3-5 = classic supersaw stack.
Unison detune amount (0 = in-tune, 1 = +/-50 cents spread).
Unison stereo spread (0 = mono, 1 = voices spread hard L-R).

Analog drift - slow per-voice pitch wander (up to +/-10 cents at max).
Default 0 = digitally perfect. Raise for Juno/Prophet/CS-80 analog warmth.
Most audible on sustained chords and pads (each voice drifts independently).
Number of bursts to fire at noteOn (1-8).

Modifier - context-dependent: pulse width (PULSE), detune (dual-osc),
FM depth (BELL), spread mix (SPREAD OCT / SPREAD 5TH).
Master output level for this engine (0..1, default 0.8).

Depth: strength of modulation. Center (0) = no effect. Right (+) applies the curve as drawn. Left (-) inverts the curve (useful for going the opposite direction without redrawing). Double-click to reset.

Length: how long the envelope plays (0 -> 1). Discrete steps: 1/8, 1/4, 3/8, 1/2, 5/8, 3/4, 7/8, 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 beats. TEMPO on = beats (4 = 1 bar at 4/4), TEMPO off = seconds. Notes shorter than this get the remainder released over the amp release time.
Timbre Blend - crossfades Part A toward Part B (0..1)
Brownian rolloff - 0 flat / 1 brown noise (~6 dB/oct)
Blur Time - kernel width scale (0..2, default 1)
Vibrato Envelope - onset delay (0 instant .. 1 slow)
Legato Limit - max glide time cap (seconds)
Filter 1 Cutoff Offset - shifts F1 cutoff up/down by this amount (semitones)
Filter 2 Cutoff Offset - shifts F2 cutoff up/down by this amount (semitones)
Part A Timbre Filter Mask Cutoff (Hz) - limits which harmonics pass through Part A's timbre
Part B Timbre Filter Mask Cutoff (Hz) - limits which harmonics pass through Part B's timbre
LFO Rate (global) - cycle length for every target's LFO source
LFO Shape (global) - Sine / Triangle / Saw / Square
Phaser Mask Rate - spectral notch spacing
Pitch Freq - note offset in semitones (-24..+24)

Strum Tension - curve (-1 end / 0 linear / +1 start)

controls.label: Realtime Pitch OFF
controls.tip: Turns on realtime pitch correction.  Tightens vocals to the Root/Scale picked below as they play, in both live monitoring and recorded-clip playback.  Use the BaySickPitch sub-tab for offline note-by-note pitch editing.
0..100 ms.  Sets how fast vocals snap to the target note.  Low values = instant robotic hard-tune sound; high values = transparent natural correction.

0..100 %.  Sets how aggressively the correction pulls pitch toward the target.  100 = full snap to in-scale notes; 0 = pitch passes through unchanged.  60-80 % is typical for natural-sounding correction.
0..100 %.  Adds tiny random pitch wobble after correction so corrected vocals don't sound mechanical.  Higher = more natural variation.

-100..+100 cents.  Shifts the vocal-tract resonance independently of pitch.  Negative = chestier / deeper-sounding voice; positive = brighter / smaller voice.  Useful for subtly resexing or reshaping a vocal's character.

controls.label: Formant Preserve
controls.tip: Keeps the vocal character intact while correction shifts pitch.  On = natural sound at any correction amount; Off = classic pitch-shift artifacts (chipmunk-up, demon-down).
